text: Subject to any restrictions imposed by law, every citizen shall have the right to acquire, hold, transfer or otherwise dispose of property, and no property shall be compulsorily acquired, nationalised or requisitioned save by authority of law.

Sale is a transfer of ownership in exchange for a price paid or promised or part-paid and part-promised. Such transfer, in the case of tangible immoveable property of the value of one hundred taka and upwards... shall be made only by a registered instrument.

section_title: Documents of which registration is compulsory
text: The following documents shall be registered, if the property to which they relate is situated in a district... (a) instruments which purport or operate to create, declare, assign, limit or extinguish, whether in present or in future, any right, title or interest... to or in immovable property.

No holding or portion of a holding of a raiyat shall be transferred by sale, gift, or exchange unless the raiyat has held the land for at least three years... except with the permission of the Government or the prescribed authority.

section_title: Ceiling on acquisition of agricultural land
text: No malik shall be entitled to acquire any land which together with the land already owned by him exceeds sixty standard bighas in the aggregate.

law_title: Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Act
section_title: Publication of preliminary notice of acquisition
text: Whenever it appears to the Government that any property in any part of Bangladesh is needed or likely to be needed for any public purpose... a preliminary notice to that effect shall be published in the official Gazette.

An easement is a right which the owner or occupier of certain land possesses, as such, for the beneficial enjoyment of that land, to do and continue to do something, or to prevent and continue to prevent something being done, in or upon, or in respect of, certain other land not his own.
The Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, order a survey of any land in any district for the purpose of preparing or revising records of rights.
Every non-agricultural tenant shall hold the land on such terms and conditions as may be agreed upon between him and his landlord, subject to the provisions of this Act.

Any property declared as enemy property under the Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1969, shall be managed and disposed of in accordance with rules made by the Government.
This Code shall apply to the design, construction, and use of all buildings and structures on land in Bangladesh, ensuring safety, health, and environmental standards.

law_title: Real Estate Development and Management Act
text: No person shall undertake any real estate project without registering the project with the authority constituted under this Act.

law_title: Land Crime Prevention and Remedy Act
text: A deed or information presented in any land-related proceeding can be considered fraudulent based on reasonable grounds by the relevant authority, leading to penalties as prescribed.
The Government shall maintain updated records of land ownership to facilitate transparent transactions and reduce disputes.
No person shall extract sand or soil from any land without obtaining a license from the appropriate authority.

law_title: Haat and Bazaar (Establishment and Management) Act
text: Land designated for haat or bazaar shall be allocated by the local authority in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

section_title: Survey of lands in Hill Tracts
text: The Government may direct a survey of lands in the Chittagong Hill Tracts to prepare or revise khatiyans for accurate land records.
The Government may requisition any immovable property for a limited period during a public emergency, with compensation as prescribed.
No homestead land up to one acre held by a debtor shall be sold in execution of a decree for debt repayment.
All mortgages of occupancy lands shall be treated as usufructuary mortgages for a period not exceeding fifteen years.
When the Government is satisfied that any particular land is needed for a public purpose... a declaration shall be made to that effect.

law_title: Land Use and Ownership Rights Act
text: The Government shall issue a Certificate of Land Ownership to confirm title, supported by digital smart cards.
Land use shall be regulated to ensure sustainable development and compliance with zoning laws.
The administration of land in the Chittagong Hill Tracts shall be governed by a combination of customary laws and regulations prescribed by the Government.
The Government may direct a survey of any land for the purpose of ascertaining boundaries or preparing maps.
